# QuickDownload — Pro Media Downloader

> High-performance, clean media extraction tool for Instagram Reels & YouTube Videos/Shorts with zero compression, sub-second metadata parsing, and privacy-first direct downloads.

Created and engineered by **Shashikant Raj | Data Analyst** (Brand: **SASHIBITCODE**).

- **Canonical URL**: https://quick-d.vercel.app/
- **Creator Portfolio**: https://sashibitcode.vercel.app/
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/sashibitcode/quickdownload
- **Full Architecture & Spec**: https://quick-d.vercel.app/llms-full.txt

## Key Capabilities
- **YouTube Downloader**: High-definition video, audio extraction, and shorts normalization with resilient player client fallback chain.
- **Instagram Downloader**: Public reels, clips, and posts extraction with session cookie authentication support.
- **Speed & Reliability**: In-memory metadata caching, background streaming download queue, and automatic temporary file garbage collection.
- **Design System**: Cinematic cyberpunk glassmorphism UI built with Vite, React, and Vanilla CSS.
- **Privacy Guarantee**: No database tracking, no analytics telemetry, zero advertisement popups.
